title: Keep balances low before statement close
rationale: Current utilization is already a strength worth preserving.
action: Continue paying down statement balances early so reported utilization stays in the single digits.

title: Maintain perfect payment history
rationale: Payment consistency is helping this profile.
action: Keep autopay enabled and monitor for any due-date changes after account servicing updates.

title: Apply selectively only when it improves your mix
rationale: There is no inquiry pressure on this file right now.
action: Keep future applications limited to products that materially improve rewards, limits, or credit mix.

title: Monitor credit reports monthly
rationale: Ongoing monitoring helps catch balance spikes, late marks, and inquiry errors early.
action: Review all three bureau reports and track balances before statement dates each month.
expected_impact: Improves control over score changes and dispute response time.

title: Reduce card balances below 30% utilization
rationale: High utilization is one of the strongest negative signals in this file.
action: Direct upcoming payments toward the highest-balance cards first and avoid new card spend until total utilization drops below 30%.
expected_impact: Can improve score within one or two reporting cycles if balances fall materially.

rationale: Recent delinquency damage will fade only if new payments stay perfect.

expected_impact: Prevents additional score damage and supports gradual recovery.

title: Add depth slowly as the file matures
rationale: A thin file can cap score upside even when everything is paid on time.
action: Let current accounts age first, then consider one additional no-fee revolving account only after six months of stable history.
expected_impact: Can improve scoring depth without creating unnecessary inquiry pressure.
